name: Komori Corporation
summary: Komori Corporation engages in the manufacture, sale, and repair of printing presses in Japan, North America, Europe, and Greater China. The company offers include offset printing presses, including the LITHRONE, ENTHRONE, SPICA, and SYSTEM series; digital printing systems that include J-throne 29 and Impremia series; KP-Connect series; H-UV series; CMS based on offset printing that a press maker can provide K series; print quality control systems comprising KHS-AI, PDC, PQA, PCC, and KID series; currency printing presses; CHAMBON series packaging printing presses and automation and labor savings; and PEPIO series gravure offset printing machines for fine lines.
